usedFor: Microsoft Dynamics CRM holds opportunities, leads and orders, and Freshsales Classic updates a deal through “Update Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Opportunity” in Microsoft Dynamics CRM, then “Update Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A new opportunity can move a matching deal forward, changing its amount, stage or close date.

watchOut: The opportunity must carry a deal ID or name, because “Update Deal” looks the deal up by one of them.
